annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 92/53/EEC of 18 June 1992 amending Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 92/53/EEC of 18 June 1992 amending Directive 70/156/EEC on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 225
annotation.summary_en: 1992 Council Directive amending Directive 70/156/EEC to establish a mandatory Community type-approval procedure for motor vehicles (initially category M1) and trailers, including certificates of conformity, mutual recognition, small-series exemptions and conformity of production. It contains no AI or automation content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Replaces Articles 1-16 of Directive 70/156/EEC with a Community vehicle type-approval procedure
Member States must register and permit sale of vehicles only with a valid certificate of conformity
Exemptions for small series and new technologies, with Commission approval
Member States may refuse or ban vehicles posing a serious road safety risk
Committee for Adaptation to Technical Progress established; application from 1 January 1993
